resources.string: Remembers the EQ preset picked for each song, then re-applies it automatically the next time that song plays — no need to switch presets manually every time.

Skips ALL software signal processing (EQ, Vocal, Balance, Stereo Expansion, Mono, Limiter) AND requests a hardware AUDIO OFFLOAD path to the connected device/USB DAC. Other knob positions don’t change, just temporarily frozen. Offload support depends on the device & song format — if unsupported, it automatically falls back to the software bypass (still fully functional).
Temporarily turns off all 10-band EQ processing (preamp & bands stay saved — turn it back on anytime).
Overlaps the current song’s fade-out with the next song’s fade-in on automatic track changes — different from GAPLESS, which just removes silence with no overlap.
Custom preset “%1$s” will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored. Built-in presets (Flat/Rock/Pop/Jazz/etc) are not affected.
Lower = louder overall, but the limiter kicks in more often on EQ presets with big/overlapping boosts. Higher = safer headroom, but quieter for those same presets.
When ON, left & right channels are combined into mono (identical L+R on both channels) — always overrides Stereo Expansion. When OFF, the original stereo image or Stereo Expansion result is used.
OFFLOAD hardware ACTIVE — this song is genuinely using the direct-path route to the DAC.
OFFLOAD not active for this song — automatically falling back to software bypass (still bit-perfect).

Automatically measures & matches loudness across songs — a song that hasn’t been measured yet gets measured while you listen, then the gain is remembered for next time. Automatically disabled while BIT-PERFECT MODE is on.
Gently holds back signal peaks (soft-knee, threshold around -0.9 dBFS) so large EQ boosts don’t hard-clip.
This song has no saved preset yet — pick a preset above
This song hasn’t been measured yet — measuring while it plays
BALANCE shifts relative left/right volume. STEREO EXPANSION widens (>100%%) or narrows (<100%%) the stereo image via Mid/Side processing, 0%% equals full mono.
Preamp controls overall gain before the 10-band EQ. The Bass/Treble sliders here are a shortcut straight to the 31Hz & 16kHz bands — use the EQU tab for full 10-band control.
VOCAL BASS adds vocal warmth (~200Hz), VOCAL TREBLE adds clarity/articulation (~4.5kHz) — both independent from BASS/TREBLE in the TONE tab.
Turns on vocal enhancement — two dedicated filters (body ~200Hz & clarity ~4.5kHz) separate from the 10-band EQ in the EQU tab, so vocals stand out without changing the active preset.
